entities.name: Salamzuri
entities.description: Elven city in the Uktabi Jungle built by the Quirion that accompanied Mangara to Jamuraa; a sanctuary that never fell.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: Accompanied to Jamuraa by the Quirion.

entities.name: Mirage Wars
entities.description: War during which the elves fled into Salamzuri.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who phased out north-western Jamuraa.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Destroyed the time rift over Zhalfir.

events.summary: The elves flee into Salamzuri when the Mirage Wars begin; it never falls.
events.quote: the elves were forced to flee into Salamzuri when the Mirage Wars began

events.summary: Teferi phases Salamzuri out with the rest of north-western Jamuraa.
events.quote: when the planeswalker Teferi wanted to spare it from the horrors of the Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: Jeska destroys the time rift and Salamzuri is removed from existence, then returns with Zhalfir.
events.quote: It was removed from existence when Jeska destroyed the time rift over Zhalfir

relations.quote: built in the Uktabi Jungle by the Quirion
